title: featurePlanGraphUncertainty
responsibility: Classify committed graph uncertainty by possible page reachability.

inputs.name: references
inputs.description: Committed uncertain references for metadata overload.

outputs.name: featurePlanGraphUncertainty
outputs.description: String overload preserves generated trim. Metadata overload returns sorted deduplicated node/reason/detail errors for page-reachable or unclassifiable uncertainty, using reverse graph traversal excluding scenario edges; proven unrelated test/script paths are omitted. Missing/duplicate/dangling graphs and unknown owners fail closed; known inactive pages are not active consumers.
